pages.text: You have discovered that small sentient whirlwinds sometimes spontaneously form in the desert. It seems that the wind itself carries some arcane power. Through Sky Ritual, you can create a Guster loyal to you.
These whirlwinds hurl sand, drawing nearby entities in and throwing them away—though thankfully, this does not affect you or your other servants. Right-clicking a Guster servant with Sand heals it.
